propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria through multiple seams, allowing project disables to be ignored, activated project DET criteria to disappear, and separate reads to describe different repository states
A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must compile effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, and metadata with a deterministic digest before any selection or model call
Code-review project LLM criteria must enforce non-empty applies_to globs or the explicit repository-wide spelling ['**'], rejecting empty lists with clear remediation guidance
The applies_to: ['**'] spelling must select criteria unconditionally even when changed_files is empty, preserving the prior ungated behavior of the [] short-circuit

Existing shared _validate_applies_to must remain empty-list-legal for plan-review and other gates, with the stricter non-empty-glob rule applied only to code-review project criteria at snapshot compile time
Contract tests must prove snapshot-derived selections match current behavior for overlayless repos and capture approved corrections for disables, retunes, and project DET inclusion
